title: 互感电压与耦合系数
statement: 正弦电流源 İ_s = 2∠0° A（有效值），ω = 50 rad/s，从同名端（•）流入线圈 L_1。L_1 = 0.2 H，L_2 = 0.8 H，互感 M = 0.2 H，线圈 L_2 开路（c、d 两端不接负载）。
取 U̇_1 = U̇_a（L_1 两端电压，a 端为 +），U̇_2 = U̇_cd（L_2 两端电压，c 端为 +），a、c 都在同名端一侧。求 U_1、U_2 的有效值和 U̇_2 的相位，并判断耦合系数 k。

questions.ask: L_1 两端电压有效值 U_1 = ?
questions.explain: L_2 开路，İ_2 = 0，L_1 上只有自感电压：U̇_1 = jωL_1·İ_s = j10 × 2 = j20 V，U_1 = 20 V。
L_2 中没有电流，只有互感电压：U_2 = ωM·I_s = 50 × 0.2 × 2 = 20 V。
电流从 L_1 的同名端流入，在 L_2 上产生的互感电压以 L_2 的同名端为正：U̇_2 = jωM·İ_s = 20∠90° V，超前 İ_s 90°。

questions.ask: 两线圈的耦合系数 k = ?
choiceExplain: 0.25 = M²/(L_{1}L_{2}) = 0.04/0.16，忘了开方（那是 k²）；也等于 M/L_2，只用了一个线圈的电感。
全耦合要求 M = √(L_{1}L_{2}) = 0.4 H，这里 M 只有 0.2 H。

hints: L_2 开路，所以 İ_2 = 0：L_1 上只有自感电压，L_2 上只有互感电压。
互感电压 U̇_2 = jωM·İ_1，其“+”在与 İ_1 流入端互为同名端的那一端。
solution: **2. 线圈方程。** U̇_1 = jωL_1·İ_1 + jωM·İ_2，U̇_2 = jωM·İ_1 + jωL_2·İ_2（两电流都从同名端流入，电压以同名端为正）。L_2 开路，İ_2 = 0，İ_1 = İ_s = 2∠0° A。

en.title: Mutual voltage and the coupling coefficient
statement: A sinusoidal current source I_s = 2∠0° A (rms), ω = 50 rad/s, drives current into the dotted (•) terminal of coil L_1. L_1 = 0.2 H, L_2 = 0.8 H, mutual inductance M = 0.2 H; coil L_2 is open (nothing is connected across c–d).

Let U_1 = U_a (the voltage across L_1, + at a) and U_2 = U_cd (the voltage across L_2, + at c); a and c are on the dotted side. Find the rms values of U_1 and U_2, the phase of U_2, and the coupling coefficient k.

questions.explain: L_2 is open, so I_2 = 0 and L_1 carries only its self-induced voltage: U_1 = jωL_1·I_s = j10 × 2 = j20 V, U_1 = 20 V.
No current flows in L_2, so its voltage is purely mutual: U_2 = ωM·I_s = 50 × 0.2 × 2 = 20 V.
The current enters L_1 at its dot, so the mutual voltage in L_2 is + at L_2's dot: U_2 = jωM·I_s = 20∠90° V, leading I_s by 90°.

choiceExplain: 0.25 = M²/(L_{1}L_{2}) = 0.04/0.16 — the square root is missing (that is k²); it also equals M/L_2, using only one coil's inductance.
Perfect coupling needs M = √(L_{1}L_{2}) = 0.4 H, but M is only 0.2 H here.
questions.explain: k = M / √(L_1·L_2) = 0.2 / √(0.2 × 0.8) = 0.2 / 0.4 = 0.5. Always k ≤ 1; k = 1 means perfect coupling.

hints: L_2 is open, so I_2 = 0: L_1 has only a self-induced voltage and L_2 only a mutual voltage.
The mutual voltage is U_2 = jωM·I_1, positive at the terminal that corresponds (by the dots) to the terminal where I_1 enters.
solution: **2. Coil equations.** U_1 = jωL_1·I_1 + jωM·I_2, U_2 = jωM·I_1 + jωL_2·I_2 (both currents entering the dots, voltages + at the dots). L_2 is open, I_2 = 0, and I_1 = I_s = 2∠0° A.
